name: Pawnix
description: A minimal curses chess client with Lichess API support
readme_summary: Pawnix is a Python-based, keyboard-first chess client designed for the terminal. It offers both local two-player games and online play through the Lichess API, supporting features like AI practice, matchmaking, and challenges.
key_features: Local two-player chess with clocks, SAN/UCI input, undo/redo, PGN import/export
Lichess integration for AI games, online matches, and challenges via Board API
OAuth with PKCE for browser-based Lichess sign-in
Customizable interface with 15 board themes, adjustable piece sizes, and visual aids
primary_use_case: Playing chess in the terminal, with seamless integration for local games and online Lichess matches.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, vintage terminal screen displaying a dynamic chess game in progress. On one side, a player's hands are poised over a keyboard, with subtle glowing lines connecting keystrokes to the on-screen chess pieces. On the other side, a digital representation of the Lichess interface is visible, showing a connection being established. Small, abstract data streams flow between the keyboard and the Lichess interface, symbolizing the API integration. The overall mood is focused and intellectual, with a clean, retro-futuristic aesthetic. The Pawnix logo is subtly integrated into the terminal's design. 3D isometric illustration style, vibrant but focused color palette, high detail.

name: waytator
description: Screenshots and video recording on wayland
readme_summary: Waytator is a C-based tool for capturing screenshots and recording video on Wayland compositors, also offering basic image and video editing capabilities. It supports features like annotation, cropping, trimming, and audio manipulation, with OCR support for text recognition.
key_features: Screenshot and video recording on Wayland
Video editing (cropping, trimming, rotation, muting, speed changes, etc.)
Build from source and package manager installation (AUR, Nix)
primary_use_case: Capturing and editing visual media (screenshots and video recordings) on Wayland display servers.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, stylized artist's studio where a magical quill pen hovers over a digital canvas. The quill is actively drawing a vibrant screenshot on one side of the canvas, while on the other side, it's trimming and re-arranging segments of a video timeline, like cutting and pasting film strips. Subtle glowing lines connect the quill to a small, stylized Wayland compositor icon in the background, representing the capture source. The overall mood is creative and productive, with soft, digital lighting. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a bright, inviting color palette, featuring the name 'waytator' subtly etched on the canvas.

name: ytconverter
description: The ytconverter is a CLI tool for downloading YouTube videos in various format directly from the terminal. It leverages popular libraries (yt-dlp) and frameworks within the Python ecosystem to handle video downloading, format conversion, metadata handling and many more!
readme_summary: YTConverter is a Python-based command-line interface (CLI) tool designed for downloading and converting YouTube videos. It supports various formats, resolutions, playlists, and subtitles, offering a user-friendly interactive experience directly from the terminal.
primary_use_case: Downloading and converting YouTube videos from the command line.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized robot arm in a clean, modern workshop, holding a YouTube play button icon. The robot arm is in the process of 'downloading' the video content, represented by streams of colorful digital data flowing from the icon into a series of neatly organized boxes labeled 'MP3', 'MP4', and 'Subtitles'. Subtle UI elements showing resolution options and download progress are visible on a nearby holographic screen. The overall mood is efficient and user-friendly, with a bright, inviting color palette. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clear, bold lines and a focus on the transformation metaphor.

name: IPTV
description: M3U Playlist for free TV channels
readme_summary: This repository provides an M3U playlist containing links to free TV channels from around the world. It aims to aggregate publicly available streams for easy access via IPTV players.
primary_use_case: To provide users with a curated list of free, globally accessible TV channels in an M3U format for playback on IPTV-compatible devices and software.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, stylized world map where each country is represented by a glowing television screen displaying a unique channel icon. A digital stream of light flows from a central point, branching out to connect all the screens, symbolizing the M3U playlist aggregating global content. Subtle UI elements resembling an IPTV player interface are overlaid on the map. The overall mood is bright and accessible, with a clean, modern flat design style. The repository name 'IPTV' is subtly integrated into the flow of the digital stream.

name: helix
readme_summary: Helix is a post-modern modal text editor written in Rust, inspired by Kakoune and Neovim. It focuses on a unique editing model with multiple selections and integrates advanced features like built-in language server support and smart syntax highlighting via tree-sitter.
key_features: Smart, incremental syntax highlighting and code editing via tree-sitter
primary_use_case: A highly efficient and modern text editing experience for developers, particularly those who appreciate modal editing paradigms and advanced code intelligence.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan, embodying the 'Helix' editor, meticulously sculpting a complex structure from raw, glowing digital clay. The artisan uses two distinct, glowing tools simultaneously, representing multiple selections, to shape the clay with precision. The raw clay is fed into the scene via streams of code snippets and data, while the sculpted form emerges as a beautifully rendered, complex software component. Subtle UI elements reminiscent of a code editor interface are integrated into the artisan's workbench. The scene is set in a futuristic, minimalist workshop with clean lines and a vibrant, energetic color palette, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on clarity and detail.
